description: In tests/trusted_issuer.rs, store_with_trusted_ca_cert_path() explicitly drops tmp before returning the store. TrustedIssuerStore does not hold a file reference after from_config returns, so the drop is safe. A reader unfamiliar with this could assume the store needs the file to stay alive. Add a comment: 'from_config reads and parses the PEM at construction time; the tempfile can be dropped immediately.']
title: auth: trusted_issuer test helper drops tempfile before returning store — needs comment
